home.title: Automate Telegram Notifications with Cloudflare Workers
home.subtitle: Deploy isolated edge workers to your personal Cloudflare account in 1-click. Securely dispatch alerts, webhook triggers, and channel broadcasts with Argon2 security.
home.feature1Desc: Top-tier password security with OWASP Argon2id, and hardware-grade AES-256-GCM encryption for all sensitive tokens.
home.feature2Desc: Automated provisioning directly into your own Cloudflare account using official Cloudflare REST APIs.
home.feature3Desc: Effortlessly broadcast markdown reports and structured crash logs to your channels via custom webhooks.
